name: Completion Requires Independent Specification Authority
text: Completion is an authority question. The benchmark separates an agent's completion claim from authoritative state. Across seven models, formal completion claims exceeded official evaluator passes by 28.7 to 37.9 percentage points. This evidence extends the requirement for execution-time artifacts that qualified providers can evaluate. It does not establish that every necessary data boundary or attribution rule was enforced. Those findings are limited to the tested software tasks, models, and evaluators.
